statement: ∀ b : ℂ, b ≠ 0 → Function.Injective (fun r : R p => r • b)
proof:
intro b hb r s hrs
have hc : (algebraMap ℚ ℂ (r : ℚ)) * b = (algebraMap ℚ ℂ (s : ℚ)) * b := hrs
have he : algebraMap ℚ ℂ (r : ℚ) = algebraMap ℚ ℂ (s : ℚ) := mul_right_cancel₀ hb hc
apply Subtype.ext
exact (algebraMap ℚ ℂ).injective he
